dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: *sigh* Some of these people have no taste, whatsoever... It's like they're actively trying to hurt my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: The way people dress in Nasha Town, of course! This place is an aesthetic wasteland.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: Look at those poor children! The way their outfits are made up... There's no rhyme or reason — and there's certainly no taste! It's no different from the town itself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: You're leaving already? Won't you at least let me give you a free makeover?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Street chic has its own fashionable charm.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: You're not trying to tell me you consider this decadent streetwear fashionable, are you? True beauty needs to stand the test of time.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: The way I see it, the only streetwear worthy of a place in the shrines of beauty is Fontainian — elegant and refined.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you look at something else?

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: My eyes can't unsuffer what they've already seen!

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: Do you know who the most fashionable crowd in Nasha Town is? The Fatui! It's enough to make one weep.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: Having said that, your own outfit looks mighty fine — this blend of colors — it's like bathing in a spring breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Miss Kaunea, about the Fontaine fashion magazine you wanted us to get in touch with — we're already on it, though I'll have to ask for your patience in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: Thank you, little Jahoda... Huh. Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Um... m—may I ask... w—what you're looking at? Is there something on my face????

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: No, no, no, I just realized that you have really cute features. With the right makeup and styling, you'll look amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? I—I'm not the subject you're looking for... Please...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Now??? Here??? No, no, no, no, no! What if someone—)

dialogues.speaker: Kaunea
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you definitely are! Trust me!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I—I—I... There's something I've to go take care of! I'll see you again, Miss Kaunea!
